faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about sale locator.

items.question: What is Sale Locator?
items.answer: Sale Locator helps you discover the best nearby sales, trending discounts, flash offers, and store promotions in your city all in one place.

items.question: How do I find deals near my location?
items.answer: You can allow location access or manually select your city. We then show nearby store offers, trending discounts, and relevant local deals.

items.question: Are the deals and offers updated regularly?
items.answer: Deals are requested when the page loads and when you search. Results come from third-party providers and merchants, so availability and freshness can change; verify the final price and promotion on the merchant page.

items.question: Do I need to create an account to use Sale Locator?
items.answer: No, you can browse sales and explore offers without creating an account. The deal-alert form is a coming-soon preview and does not collect or submit an email address.

items.question: Can I use Sale Locator on mobile devices?
items.answer: Yes, Sale Locator is fully responsive and works smoothly on mobile phones, tablets, laptops, and desktop screens.

items.question: What kind of deals can I find here?
items.answer: You can explore electronics offers, fashion discounts, beauty deals, home essentials, trending flash sales, and nearby local store promotions.
